title: Self-Parking Savings of a Stay: Guest Folios Computation Note
content:
The Ashbury Rewards parking savings that the self-parking of a stay receives on Guest Folios are an amount for the whole stay, worked out from the self-parking lines of the folio.

## Definition

The self-parking savings of a stay are the number of self-parking lines of the stay times the brand's self-parking rate times the self-parking savings percent, rounded half up to the cent at the end. The self-parking savings percent is the member parking saving percent of 4%.

Read element by element:

| Element | Meaning |
|---|---|
| The number of self-parking lines | Every self-parking line posted on the folio of the stay |
| The brand's self-parking rate | The brand's self-parking figure per night parked, as shown in the brand parking schedule |
| The self-parking charged | The number of self-parking lines times the brand's self-parking rate |
| The self-parking savings percent | One percentage, the member parking saving percent of 4%, applied once to the self-parking charged |
| Rounding | Half up, to the cent, once, on the savings of the stay |

## Worked example (hypothetical figures)

Inputs: five self-parking lines on the folio and a self-parking rate of $20.00.

1. Self-parking charged: 5 times $20.00, $100.00.
2. Savings: $100.00 at 4%, $4.00.
3. Rounded half up to the cent: **$4.00**.

A second hypothetical stay with seven self-parking lines at $18.50: 7 times $18.50 is $129.50; at 4% that is $5.18; rounded half up to the cent, **$5.18**.

## Points of judgement

- **The count is of lines.** Each self-parking line of the stay counts once.
- **The rate is the brand's.** The brand's self-parking rate per night parked is used for every line.
- **One rounding.** Intermediate figures are not rounded; only the savings of the stay are.
